description: Election Commission - T. Rajina was elected as the member of the Kayts P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Kayts Pradeshiya Sabha (local government body) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local authority position, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls under election-related matters.
